And Jehovah{H3068} came,{H935} and stood,{H3320} and called{H7121} as at other times,{H6471} Samuel,{H8050} Samuel.{H8050} Then Samuel{H8050} said,{H559} Speak;{H1696} for thy servant{H5650} heareth.{H8085}
